name: Void Components
desc: A purple crystal gathered in the Sea of Decay that contains a special power. The most effective way to release the crystal's power is to use it for synthesis.

eff.name: Boost: SPD Up
eff.desc1: Applies SPD Up when used during equipment enhancement.

eff.name: Boost: Skill Up
eff.desc1: Applies Skill Damage Up when used during equipment enhancement.

eff.name: Boost: Skill Cooldown
eff.desc1: Applies Reduce Skill Cooldown when used during equipment enhancement.
